An elephant was dying in a lake, with one flower in his trunk. As the story goes, Gajendra, the king of elephants, went to drink with his family. Suddenly, a crocodile grabbed his leg.
He pulled. The crocodile pulled. For a thousand years, the story says. His family tried, and gave up. One by one, they left him. His strength was gone.
Wait, what did he do? He plucked a lotus, raised it to the sky, and called out to Narayana with his last breath. And Vishnu came flying on Garuda, so fast he forgot his own crown.
One spin of the chakra, and Gajendra was free. That's why we offer God a lotus. When everyone leaves, he still comes. Comment Hari if he has saved you.
